notes: Empty the TR Cache now opens your inventory for you. Some players were told the run couldn't start because their inventory window wasn't open — but standing at the TR NPC you usually only have the cache and bank up, not your pack. The plugin now opens the inventory itself (the same action as the inventory keybind) instead of refusing, and reopens it if the bank fills and overflow needs somewhere to land. There's a new 'Open inventory' option (on by default) if you'd rather it never touched your inventory. The cache and bank still have to be opened at the NPC — the game gives no way to open those remotely.
